scene futabatired1
A wise man once said “Knowledge is power.”
But I'm not very wise. So I say, “Knowledge is annoying.”

Not just because it eats up a good portion of my daily life now, though. It’s more so the fact that learning about some guys with weird hair who existed a long time ago isn’t going to change anything.

Or...at least it wouldn’t change anything in most contexts. Frankly, knowing more about the past iterations of me might change my behavior in some way, but...in most contexts, history is just history.
The past (Again, in most contexts) will only repeat to a certain extent.
And learning things like when a castle was seized or some man was executed isn’t going to prevent things like that from happening in the future.
Wherever man exists, turmoil will follow.
And for that reason, I will continue to zone out as Imani speaks and pay more attention to Kirin slowly unbuttoning her shirt while staring at me.
I wonder how far she’ll go?
: ...and while the seizure of Heiankyo, or “Kyoto” as we refer to it today, brought an end to the Warring States period, Nobu-kun still had a bunch of work to do in terms of stabilizing Japan.
: So with this brand new territory added to his ever-growing list of cool hang-out spots, he set his sights on the remaining Ashikaga shogunate, but would not finish the job until five years later.
: Now, for extra credit on the test we aren’t going to take on this, can anyone tell me the name of the final Ashikaga shogun?
: Yes! Pick me!
: Can anyone who hasn’t answered every single other question tell me the name of the final Ashikaga shogun?
: I can!
scene futabatired2
: Then, Kirin-
scene futabatired3
: Bitch, what you doin’ over there? Button up yo’ God damn shirt.
: Oh, whoops.
: “Whoops” my ass. You know better than to strip in class. I bet you don’t even know the name of the shogun, do you? You were just trying to make me lose my job.
: I do know actually. It’s Ashikaga Yoshiaki. And, if you want his parents’ names as well, they were Ashikaga Yoshiharu and the daughter of Konoe Hisamichi, Keiju-in.
scene futabatired4
: Man, see what you’re capable of when you quench your thirst? That was a genuinely good answer. Ten points to the second floor.
scene futabatired5
: Points?! Nobody said there would be points! But surely my floor must have more than the other on account of how many correct answers I’ve had today.
: Nah. Score’s ten to zip right now. But you’ll have plenty of time to catch up.
: Sensei?
scene futabatired6
: Yeah? What-
scene futabatired7
: Woah, what the hell happened to you?
: Can I borrow you for a minute? In private, please.
: Jesus, Futaba. You look like you were hit by a truck. Shouldn’t you go to the nurse’s office instead?
: That won’t be necessary, Miss Imai. I just need to talk to Sensei for a minute. It won’t take very long.
: Is...everything alright?
: Bro, look at her. You really think everything is alright? Hell nah. We’ve gotta find the truck driver who did this. Ain’t nobody messing with my girls during school hours.
: Sensei? Now?
scene black
: Sorry, Imani. I can’t head the class anymore. You’re going to have to take over for me.
: This motherfucker really just said, “I can’t head the class anymore.” Ain’t no way. While I’ve got the stick in my hand and everything.
: I’m glad you understand. Come on, Futaba.
: Yeah, yeah. Guess I’ll just keep doing the same damn thing I’ve been doing this whole- Kirin! Button your damn uniform! I ain’t telling you again!
: Booooooo! Free the nipple! Imani’s not progressive enough!
: Y’all really just ignoring the stick, huh?
scene futabatired8
: Just a little tired, that’s all.
: You didn’t even give me a chance to say anything.
: I already knew what you were going to say. And also, thanks for letting me talk to you in here outside of your regular office hours. I realize that must be kind of annoying for you.
: Well, it’s not like you show up during office hours anymore...so this is nice. It’ll let us catch up a bit. Which, by the look of it, we kind of need to.
: Yes, I bet you’re wondering why I dragged you away from the class. Or why I didn’t do my hair today. Or anything else you might be wondering because I’m clearly not acting like myself.
: And I know that. I’m well aware of it. Rin told me the same exact thing when she got home last night. Minus the hair part because I'd done my hair earlier that day.
: But anyway, when I explained to her the reason I was acting differently, she just went to sleep upstairs instead. I wonder why?
: Did...something happen?
scene futabatired9
: Why, yes. What gave it away?
Futaba’s eyes, which are normally so full of life, now appear more like those of a dying fish or a creature from the pages of some sort of horror manga.
She stares through me. And, for the first time since I’ve met her, I feel...intimidated.
But I also feel like this doesn’t have anything to do with me.
There’s no murderous intent in those lifeless fish eyes — just a tinge of desperation and...
Hopelessness.
And I know hopelessness. I’d recognize it from a mile away. Some may even call me an expert.
But what would make this girl feel that way?
: Wow. You look just as bad as I do right now.
: I think that’s on you. I’m not exactly fond of staring at you when you look like this.
: Do you not think I’m a butterfly?
: ...What?
: Would I stand out in an eclipse? Am I moving too far away from the mouth of the sky?
: Uhh...what-
: It doesn’t matter. But I have news for you. Bad news. News that puts you and everyone else in danger.
: It’s not about the end of the world, is-
: I have news for you. Bad news. News that puts you and everyone else in danger.
Well...I guess it’s not that.
: What’s the news, Futaba?...
: It’s Nodoka.
: She knows everything.
: None of our secrets are safe. None of them.
: Are you not going to say anything?
: You found out about her book, didn’t you?
scene futabatired10
: You knew?
: I did. Just like I knew she was trying to keep it from you because “you wouldn’t understand” or something like that.
: So...you’re fully aware that Nodoka is publishing a book where you go around sleeping with your students...and you’re just...okay with it?
: I mean...okay isn’t exactly accurate. I think it’s a complete invasion of privacy and it weirds me out, but...
: At the same time, it’s not like I can stop her from writing what she wants to write. I can just...not read it.
: Are you out of your mind?
: Futaba?
scene futabatired11
: Are you out of your fucking mind?! Are all of you insane?! Are all of you just okay with this?!
: Hey, calm down. Someone is going to hear you.
: So you care about that but not a detailed recollection of every single girl you’re involved with?! How does that make sense?!
: What’s in there is way more damning than anything I could possibly say to you! I’m just one piece of the puzzle!
: Sure, but it’s still a puzzle. You have to solve puzzles.
: Oh, give me a break! It’s a puzzle with like, twenty pieces max. Anyone in our class with half a brain will be able to figure out what her book really is by the second chapter.
: Then I guess we should be thankful that only half of our class is smart.
scene futabatired12
: You and Nodoka both! How can you make jokes about this?! We’re all screwed if the truth about this fucking book gets out!
: No, I’m screwed if the truth about this book gets out. The rest of you will be fine.
scene futabatired13
: Oh! Will we?! So people like Chika and Ami will just be totally cool with people like me sleeping with you because you’re taking the hit for all of us! Okay! I had no idea it worked that way!
: I...I guess I didn’t think of it like that.
: Yeah. Of course you didn’t. Because you already know the risks that come with doing what you do and you continue to do it anyway.
: But do you think I had any idea what I was getting into when I started hanging out with you? All I did was look up to you. I thought you were handsome and interesting.
: I had no fucking clue that you wanted me to suck your dick! And I also had no clue that I’d do it so easily, but here we are! Here we are, Sensei!
: Do you seriously think I’m ready for everyone else to find out about this? Do you think they’ll just let me off the hook because I’m nice?
: Or do you think that maybe this will make me a target again?! I’m the outlier! I’m the easiest one to come after! But we’re all going to be fucked!
: No one can read this! We have to put an end to it before it gets out of hand!
: There’s still time, though! We’re the only ones who know right now. And Rika. And I guess Molly and Yasu too, but they don’t really know the contents of-
: Rin and Otoha know too, Futaba.
: I mean...why else would Rin have just left when you told her what was going on last night?
scene futabatired14
: Hahah...
: Hahahah...hahahah!
scene futabatired15
: Hahahaha! HAHAHAHAHA! AaaaaaaaAAAAAAHHHHHHHH!
: We’re all fucked and no one cares but me! Amazing!
: Futaba...how much of the book did you read, exactly? Because I know it’s about all of us, I just don’t really know the...extent to which our “exploits” are included.
: She knows everything. She knows literally everything because she’s a fucking genius and all she does is watch people.
: She knows how I think. She probably knows how you think. She knows how everyone thinks because she made it her reality. She can see into our heads, Sensei.
: And you want to know the worst part?
scene futabatired16
: It’s good.
: It’s really...really good.

: I couldn’t even put it down. Well, at least not after the first time when I went into her room to yell at her. But after that, it was just straight to the end. And I loved it. But I also felt fucking violated.
: That’s why I didn’t sleep. I read the whole thing in one night. And I want to read it again. I want to know more about what everyone else thinks because I can...I can feel it changing the way I do.
: Futaba...what if the reason this is affecting you so much is because you’re Nodoka’s favorite?
scene futabatired17
: If I was her favorite, she wouldn’t include me at all! She wouldn’t just rewrite the things I told her in confidence! She wouldn’t just give away my secrets!
: But she did all of those things! And she did them well!
: But what I’m saying is she probably did them well because she’s been watching you forever, hasn’t she? She knows how you think because she knows you.
: And without knowing how anyone else reacts to this weird alternate reality she cooked up, we can’t know for sure just how accurate her re-tellings are.
: There’s no way Nodoka can just know things she wasn’t there for. So I imagine all of your parts are accurate because...well, you told her.
: You should read it, Sensei. You should find out. I only know so much, but you’ll know everything. You’ll know what’s made up.
: Do you really think I want to read a book about all of the horrible things I’ve done? I’m a narcissist, not a masochist. There’s nothing I could gain from that book but reminders and regrets.
: Do you regret me, Sensei?
: Because right now, I’m regretting you.
: And if the way you feel about me is at all what it’s like in the book, I...
scene futabatired18
: I don’t even know...
: I knew I didn’t value myself. I’ve never valued myself. And I gave away too much too early. But it was so much clearer when I was reading the book than it was in real life.
: I’m the first one...the first one who caves...and I just...I let you conquer me because I feel like you’ll leave me if I don’t.
: I become so...reliant on your existence that...that...
: That it’s like I’m barely even human by the end of the first volume...
: If the other girls find out...if they see just how much of me I let you have...
scene futabatired19
: They’re going to hurt me...
: I won’t let anyone hurt you, Futaba. And I’ll talk to Nodoka about her book. I had no idea it would affect anyone this much. Or that...any of you would even read it.
: Thank you...really.
: But Sensei...this isn’t something you should wait on. If anyone else from the class gets their hands on this, everything is going to unravel.
: Unless a good portion of it is made up, you mean.
: But if the others are anything like me...and they can confirm that what’s in there actually happened...everyone will know it’s real.
: All it takes is one person’s confirmation to cast doubt on any part of the story that you or Nodoka or anyone else says is just “made up.”
: I get it. Like I said, I’ll talk to her.
scene futabatired20
: That’s great, but...why didn’t you talk to me?
: Why didn’t any of you talk to me?...
: You all knew...you all knew that I’d bare everything in this book...that some of the biggest, most important moments of my life would be put on display...highlighted...for everyone to see...
: Do you really think that’s what a girl like me wants?...To have more people look at her when she can’t even look at herself?
: Did any of you even think about that?...
: Honestly?...No. I don’t think any of us did. Because if there was even a glimpse of that, we would have confronted Nodoka then and there.
: But this was something that was out before any of us could even do anything about it. Rin, Otoha, and I didn’t find out what was going on until people started mistaking us for cosplayers.
: Well...for all of our sakes...I hope you get through to her. Because I thought I would...and I didn’t even come close.
: I’ll do my best. It’s Nodoka, though...so I can’t really make any promises.
: I do have one question, though.
: What is it?...What are you wondering?...
: It’s just...our story is still going.
: So I was kind of wondering how the book ended.
: Like...where did she decide to cut things off?
: That’s the only part I didn’t really understand.
: The book just...ends.
: But...where does it end?
: What’s the last thing that happens?
scene futabatired21
: You wake up in a room with clocks.
scene black
